tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. chC:C.1[LeeSM, Thms. 7.5 & 21.27] Suppose $F : G \to H$ is a Lie group homomorphism.

  1. $F$ has constant rank.

  2. The kernel of $F$ is an embedded Lie subgroup of $G$.

  3. The image of $F$ is an immersed Lie subgroup of $H$.
